location.en: Big Bay Burger, by the harbor

goal.en: Order lunch for you and Mia, just the way you want it.
goal.zh: 幫自己和米亞點午餐，而且要點得剛剛好。

background: busy fast food restaurant with a long stainless steel order counter, a pickup area with plastic trays, red booth seats, a drink fountain machine, harbor view through big windows, noon

intro.en: After a long morning of errands, you and Mia are starving.
intro.zh: 跑了一整個早上的腿，你和米亞都餓扁了。

intro.en: My treat today! But you have to order. Practice, practice!
intro.zh: 今天我請客！不過要由你來點餐。多練習、多練習！

intro.en: The line moves fast. Suddenly it's your turn.
intro.zh: 隊伍前進得很快，一下子就輪到你了。

lines.en: Hi, welcome to Big Bay Burger! What can I get for you?
lines.zh: 嗨，歡迎光臨大灣漢堡！要點什麼呢？

choices.tip: 點餐用 I'll have...，套餐英文叫 combo 或 meal。

choices.en: I have the number 2 combo, please.

lines.en: You have it? Like, a coupon? Can I see it?
lines.zh: 你有？是說優惠券嗎？可以給我看一下嗎？

story.en: You search every pocket for a coupon that doesn't exist. Mia is laughing so hard she has to sit down.
story.zh: 你翻遍每個口袋，找一張根本不存在的優惠券。米亞笑到必須坐下來。

fail.why: I have... 是「我有……」，對方會以為你已經有東西。點餐要用未來式 I'll have...，表示「我要點……」。

lines.en: A set? Um, okay. Just the number 2 burger, then?
lines.zh: 一組？呃，好。那就是 2 號漢堡單點囉？

story.en: Your tray arrives with one lonely burger. No fries, no drink. Mia slowly slides half her fries over to you.
story.zh: 你的托盤上只有一個孤單的漢堡，沒有薯條也沒有飲料。米亞默默把一半薯條推到你面前。

fail.why: 台灣常說「套餐」是 set，但北美速食店多半說 combo 或 meal。點餐也別用 Give me...，說 I'll have the number 2 combo. 最自然。

lines.en: Number 2 combo. Any changes to your burger?
lines.zh: 2 號套餐。漢堡有要調整什麼嗎？

choices.tip: No + 食材 + please 是最簡單的去料說法。

lines.en: Oh, card's fine. So, no changes to the burger?
lines.zh: 喔，刷卡可以。所以，漢堡不用調整囉？

story.en: You nod. Your burger comes with extra onions, because today the onions are on the house.
story.zh: 你點了點頭。結果漢堡加了滿滿的洋蔥，因為今天洋蔥免費加量。

fail.why: 這裡的 changes 是「修改、調整」，不是找零的「零錢」（零錢是不可數的 change）。不要的食材直接說 No onions, please.。

lines.en: Not inside? Oh, onions on the side? Sure!
lines.zh: 不要放裡面？喔，洋蔥另外放？好啊！

story.en: Your burger arrives with a small cup of onions next to it. They stare at you through the whole meal.
story.zh: 你的漢堡旁邊多了一小杯洋蔥。整頓飯，它們都在旁邊盯著你。

fail.why: 「不要放洋蔥」直譯成 Don't put onion inside 很不自然，還可能被聽成 on the side（另外放）。點餐去料直接說 No onions, please.。

lines.en: Got it. And for here or to go?

choices.tip: for here 是內用，to go 是外帶。

choices.en: Here. Bring it to our table.

lines.en: Bring it...? Sorry, we call your number at the counter.
lines.zh: 送過去……？抱歉，我們是叫號到櫃檯取餐的。

story.en: You sit and wait for someone to bring your food. They never do. Your number is called five times, and your fries go cold.
story.zh: 你坐著等人送餐，結果根本沒人來。你的號碼被叫了五次，薯條也冷掉了。

fail.why: 北美速食店大多是叫號後自己到櫃檯取餐，不會送到桌邊。內用只要說 For here, please.，然後留意叫號。

lines.en: Uh... everyone here is hungry. It'll be a few minutes.
lines.zh: 呃……這裡每個人都很餓。要等幾分鐘喔。

story.en: Somehow, everyone who ordered after you gets their food first. Mia pretends she doesn't know you.
story.zh: 不知道為什麼，比你晚點的人都先拿到餐了。米亞假裝不認識你。

fail.why: 對店員說 Hurry 很像在催促命令，就算肚子餓也不太禮貌。說 For here, please. Thanks! 對方會一樣快幫你準備。

lines.zh: 沒問題。你的號碼是 47 號，請慢用！

lines.en: Combo, no onions, for here. You order like a local now!
lines.zh: 套餐、不加洋蔥、內用。你點餐已經跟本地人一樣了！

story.en: When they call number 47, you pick up a hot tray of food. Not a single onion in sight.
story.zh: 叫到 47 號時，你從櫃檯端回熱騰騰的餐點，連一片洋蔥都沒看到。

notes.explain: 點餐時 I'll have... 比 I want... 更自然。套餐在北美多半叫 combo 或 meal。

example.en: I'll have the chicken sandwich meal, please.
example.zh: 我要雞肉三明治套餐，謝謝。

notes.explain: 去掉某樣食材就說 No + 食材 + please；要多加說 Extra + 食材；要另外放說 on the side。

example.en: No pickles and extra cheese, please.
example.zh: 不要酸黃瓜，起司加量，謝謝。

notes.explain: for here 是內用，to go 是外帶。有些地方會問 Eat in or take out?，意思一樣。

example.en: To go, please. Can I get a bag?
example.zh: 外帶，可以給我一個袋子嗎？

notes.explain: I have a burger. 是「我手上有漢堡」，I'll have a burger. 才是「我要點漢堡」。少了 'll，意思差很多。

example.en: I'll have a small coffee, please.
example.zh: 我要一杯小杯咖啡，謝謝。

notes.explain: 北美速食店通常會給你號碼或收據，叫號後自己去櫃檯取餐。吃完後也要自己把托盤和垃圾收好。
